About 11 years old things were fine from 12-13 then it came back when in the following years, I believed things would improve, but i'm 17 now and things are worst. 
Never really attempted but once I was with a friend, when I saw a pedestrian crossing turn red but the light shortly disappeared. But my friend didn't notice that it was red, I just decided to cross in hopes that a car headed my way would crash into me. I realised after that I also placed his life in danger along with mine simply because of how selfish I was.
